listDetail.countsFinePrint: Worked out, not attached: an item counts towards every intention whose funding and category it matches, when the list starts inside that intention's window. The figures overlap — never add them.
listDetail.generatedMeta: {{generator}} · {{pages}} pp asked{{allocation}} · its mix as it was on {{date}}

listDetail.pagesNoTarget: the pages on it — there is no target
listDetail.blockedFoot: stays on; take it off if it should not be scanned

listDetail.plannedBody_one: Its {{count}} item reads Planned until then, and In progress that morning — nobody has to act.
listDetail.plannedBody_other: Its {{count}} items read Planned until then, and In progress that morning — nobody has to act.
listDetail.overdueBody: {{scanned}}. Marking it Done moves what is on it to Digitized. Mark any that could not be digitized first, with a message.
listDetail.inProgressBody: Ends {{date}}. {{scanned}}. When the scanning room is through, mark it Done.
listActions.refusalDone: This list was marked Done meanwhile; it no longer changes.
listActions.refusalNotStarted: It has not started yet: nothing on it is being scanned.
listActions.startDescription: It was to start {{date}}; its start date becomes today.
listActions.startConsequence: It is In progress from now, and so is everything on it not held.
listActions.intentionConsequence: Intentions count a list by the day it starts, so it may count towards other ones.
listActions.historyConsequence: The history keeps the date it replaced.
listActions.doneDescription: Everything on it not marked could not be digitized moves to Digitized.
listActions.deleteDescription: What is on it returns to the pool; the list is gone.
listActions.alreadyScanned_one: {{count}} already digitized stays as it is
listActions.alreadyScanned_other: {{count}} already digitized stay as they are
listActions.notDigitizable_one: {{count}} marked could not be digitized does not; its message stands
listActions.notDigitizable_other: {{count}} marked could not be digitized do not; their message stands
listActions.blocked_one: {{count}} is blocked since listing — {{names}}. If it was not scanned, close this and mark it could not be digitized first.
listActions.blocked_other: {{count}} are blocked since listing — {{names}}. If they were not scanned, close this and mark them could not be digitized first.
listActions.doneFinal: If something on it was not scanned, mark that item first, from the ⋯ beside it. Done is final: the list stays as history and cannot be deleted.
listActions.toReady_one: {{count}} item returns to the pool as Ready — {{pages}} pp
listActions.toReady_other: {{count}} items return to the pool as Ready — {{pages}} pp
listActions.toEnqueued_one: {{count}} blocked since listing goes back to Enqueued, Ready again when the gate clears
listActions.toEnqueued_other: {{count}} blocked since listing go back to Enqueued, Ready again when the gate clears
listActions.held_one: {{count}} cancelled or not digitizable stays held
listActions.held_other: {{count}} cancelled or not digitizable stay held
listActions.deletedHistory: A list is deleted, not cancelled: no reason is asked. That they were listed on {{id}} stays in each one's history.
listActions.iterationStopped: It was scanned or stopped meanwhile.
listActions.alreadyHeld: It is already held, or it has been scanned meanwhile.
listActions.takeOff: Take it off — in the editor
listActions.notDigitizedDescription: Mark it as not digitized, with a message every asker reads.
listActions.notDigitizedPlaceholder: e.g. Pages too tightly bound to open safely; sent to conservation.
listActions.notDigitizedReach: It stays on {{name}}, marked. Marking the list Done moves every other item to Digitized; this one is not.
listActions.cancelDescription: Hold it at the gate and take it off the list.
listActions.cancelPlaceholder: e.g. Postponed — will be scheduled next quarter.
listActions.cancelReach: Held at the gate, and taken off the list. Resuming it in Documents brings it back to the pool.
